category_description: How income tax, GST and capital gains tax work in Australia.
subcategory_description: The capital gains tax discount and the changes to it.
label: CGT discount for resident individuals
context: The part of a capital gain that can be taken off when an asset has been owned for at least 12 months, for gains that accrue before 1 July 2027.

label: Minimum time an asset must be owned to get the discount
context: Counted from the day after the asset is acquired to the day before the CGT event, which is usually the date of the contract of sale.

label: CGT discount for complying super funds
context: Complying super funds can reduce a capital gain by this much on an asset held for at least 12 months. Companies cannot use the discount.

label: Minimum tax rate on certain net capital gains from 1 July 2027
context: Under changes that are now law, individuals face a minimum 30% tax on certain net capital gains that accrue on or after 1 July 2027, with cost base indexation replacing the discount for those gains.
